description: Java source code for an Android Activity 'Grid2' that displays a grid of images using a custom adapter 'ImageAdapter'. The class sets up a GridView with image thumbnails from drawable resources.

classes.name: Grid2
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a grid of framed photos using a GridView and a custom ImageAdapter.

classes.name: ImageAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to supply image views for each grid item, managing a list of drawable resource IDs.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and binds the ImageAdapter to the GridView.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of images in the thumbnail list.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position as the item object.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses an ImageView for each grid item, sets its properties, and assigns the image resource.
